name: Unbounce Landing Page Builder
description: The Unbounce connector lets Claude work directly inside your Unbounce account — creating and editing landing pages, managing A/B test variants and traffic splits, and reviewing performance without leaving the conversation. Create an AI-powered landing page process with Unbounce’s MCP so you can build, test, optimize, and manage your landing pages - no switching tools or relying on other team members. Now you have even more ways to break through one of marketing’s biggest bottlenecks: landing pages.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Unbounce Landing Page Builder to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Unbounce Landing Page Builder to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.unbounce.com/mcp?experimental=true. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Unbounce Landing Page Builder MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unbounce Landing Page Builder lists 37 MCP tools, including bulk_edit_variants, create_page_from_html, create_variant_from_existing_variant, create_variant_from_html, delete_page, delete_page_group, delete_variant, download, download_inband, get_account_plan, get_layout_hints, and get_page_stats.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Unbounce Landing Page Builder?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Unbounce Landing Page Builder in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Unbounce Landing Page Builder MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unbounce Landing Page Builder requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Unbounce Landing Page Builder?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unbounce Landing Page Builder is developed by Unbounce Marketing Solutions Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
